def optimal_score_difference(N, cards):
    # Create a DP table where dp[i][j] represents the maximum score difference
    # Alice can achieve over Bob when playing optimally with cards[i:j+1].
    dp = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]

    # Fill the DP table
    for length in range(1, N + 1):  # length of the subarray
        for i in range(N - length + 1):
            j = i + length - 1
            if length == 1:
                dp[i][j] = cards[i]
            else:
                # Alice can choose either the leftmost or the rightmost card
                dp[i][j] = max(cards[i] - dp[i + 1][j], cards[j] - dp[i][j - 1])

    return dp[0][N - 1]
